stage6.blocking_effect: Stage6 verification artifacts cannot be used as validated inputs for Stage7 until retry_request.0001 is resolved and Stage6 producer transition is promoted.

stage7.blocking_effect: Existing Stage7 evidence is debug/planning only and cannot promote verification.

stage8.blocking_effect: Current repair artifacts may guide bounded repair but cannot prove repair closure or validate Stage7 without rerun/reuse adjudication.

allowed_evidence_reuse_policy.if_any_condition_fails: Do not reuse as pass evidence; rerun Stage7 operator-leaf closure, localize failures, and route bounded repairs through Stage8.
reuse_as_promotable_evidence_allowed_onl: retry_request.0001, retry_request.0002, retry_request.0003, and retry_request.0004 are closed or explicitly superseded by checker evidence
all active barriers covering the reused Stage7 artifact and its Stage6/Stage8 dependencies are cleared or superseded in SACG memory

artifact_hash_check proves the old evidence was generated from the same generated code package, memory layout, runtime config, model/numeric policy, tool protocol, case adapter, selected execution scope, and golden-reference binding as the clean contract
required_real_tool_evidence_check proves the evidence is real tool output, not not_run, fallback, or unchecked diagnostic data
sacg_reference_check binds the evidence to promoted SACG artifacts rather than rejected Stage6 producer artifacts
data_order_trace_check, transfer_count_check, numeric_compare, and boundary_contract_check remain valid for the refined contract

approval_required_for: Any architecture, pipeline, memory layout, runtime ABI, numeric policy, or major template change proposed while resolving Stage6 or Stage8 blockers.

Any attempt to reuse previously contaminated Stage7 real-tool evidence for promotion when hash, contract binding, tool protocol, numeric/data-order scope, or SACG barrier status is ambiguous; human approval cannot replace checker evidence.
Any proposed board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime advancement before clean operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer verification evidence exists; this role does not approve backend progress.

Any waiver request to consume active-barrier Stage6, Stage7, or Stage8 artifacts as validated inputs; without sacg_memory_check and stage_artifact_trust_barrier_check evidence this must remain blocked.

artifact.input.case_adapter.reason: Required input for Stage6 retry; must be bound by verification_artifact_contract_check and case-stage checkers.

artifact.input.tool_protocols.reason: Required input for Stage6 retry; must be bound by tool_protocol_check.

artifact.stage5.design_artifact_manifest.reason: No current SACG-memory truth barrier is listed for Stage5; still must pass normal static/hash references when used for retry_request.0001.

artifact.stage6.*.reason: Covered by contamination_barrier.0001-0013 and retry_request.0001; not valid Stage7 inputs until refined/promoted and memory barriers are cleared or superseded.

artifact.stage7.*.reason: Covered by contamination_barrier.0014-0017 and 0020-0023 plus retry_request.0002 and retry_request.0004; may support localization only.

artifact.stage8.repair_execution_report.reason: Covered by contamination_barrier.0019; Stage7 verification rerun or checker-approved reuse adjudication is required before promotion.

artifact.stage8.repair_plan.reason: Covered by contamination_barrier.0018 and retry_request.0003; bounded repair must be reconciled before promotion.

contamination_barrier_resolution_require: A barrier can be cleared only by checker-bound evidence of a promoted superseding artifact or an explicit SACG memory update accepted by sacg_memory_check and stage_artifact_trust_barrier_check.

Stage6 barriers 0001-0013 require a refined Stage6 verification contract package that passes verification_plan_static_check, hierarchical_verification_plan_check, tool_protocol_check, verification_artifact_contract_check, verification_action_audit_check, llm_io_quality_check, sacg_reference_check, and sacg_static_check.

Stage7 barriers 0014-0017 and 0020-0023 require either a clean Stage7 rerun or a reuse decision proving identical clean-contract binding with artifact_hash_check, required_real_tool_evidence_check, sacg_reference_check, stage_retry_request_check, and stage_artifact_trust_barrier_check.

Stage8 barriers 0018-0019 require repair_boundary_check, causal_repair_context_check, targeted_failed_checker_rerun where applicable, and SACG memory reconciliation; the current repair report alone is not closure evidence.
No golden output modification, tolerance loosening, static-check bypass, or human-memory assertion can satisfy these requirements.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep all current SACG-memory blockers active and reject promotion; hand off mismatch details to repair.final_evidence_gate.
executable_actions.rationale: Produce the checker-consumable active blocker inventory and trust matrix from the authoritative state_summary.sacg_memory_truth instead of historical records.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep retry_request.0001 open, keep Stage6 barriers active, and block Stage7 rerun/reuse except for debug-only inspection.
executable_actions.rationale: retry_request.0001 and Stage6 contamination barriers must be resolved before any Stage7 rerun or reuse can be trusted.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep retry_request.0003 open; use Stage8 artifacts only for localization and do not promote Stage7.
executable_actions.rationale: retry_request.0003 and Stage8 barriers must be reconciled so repair artifacts are not consumed as proof without boundary and human-boundary checks.

executable_actions.on_failure: Declare existing Stage7 evidence non-reusable for promotion and require a clean operator-leaf rerun.
executable_actions.rationale: Existing Stage7 artifacts are under active contamination barriers; reuse as promotable evidence is allowed only if checker evidence proves clean-contract equivalence and SACG blockers are cleared or superseded.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote and do not proceed to single-transformer-layer; send failing boundary, trace, and numeric evidence to Stage8 repair with causal localization.
executable_actions.rationale: After Stage6 and Stage8 blockers are resolved, Stage7 must establish fresh operator-leaf closure before any higher-layer verification is trusted.

executable_actions.on_failure: Localize the single-layer causal boundary, route bounded repair to Stage8, and keep board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime blocked.
executable_actions.rationale: The required three-layer repair loop allows single-transformer-layer verification only after clean operator-leaf closure, and blocks board/backend work until this layer passes.

executable_actions.on_failure: Leave affected retry requests and contamination barriers active; repair.final_evidence_gate must reject promotion.
executable_actions.rationale: Promotion requires SACG memory to reflect that current retry requests and contamination barriers have been closed or superseded by checker-backed clean artifacts.

observations: The current blocker set is taken from state_summary.sacg_memory_truth only; historical/recent failure lessons are recovery evidence and are not used to add blockers beyond the truth object.

state_summary.sacg_memory_truth reports active_contamination_barrier_count=23, open_retry_request_count=4, and open_backtrack_request_count=0; therefore there is no current backtrack-request blocker, but there are current retry and contamination-barrier blockers.

retry_request.0001 is the first dependency: Stage6 verification gate DAG/tool protocol contract is incomplete and blocks artifact.stage6.verification_plan and artifact.stage6.verification_artifact_contract. Because Stage7 retries require artifact.stage6.verification_artifact_contract and artifact.stage6.llm_action_audit, this Stage6 retry blocks any promotable Stage7 rerun or reuse decision.

contamination_barrier.0001 through contamination_barrier.0013 mark Stage6 verification artifacts as planning/debug evidence only, including verification_plan, verification_artifact_contract, llm_action_audit, llm_io_quality, gate selector, downstream blocklist, debug schemas, and backend target discovery policy. These artifacts cannot be consumed as validated downstream inputs until a refined Stage6 transition is promoted and SACG barrier checks clear or supersede them.

retry_request.0002 and retry_request.0004 both remain open for artifact.stage7.verification_result. They are duplicate-current Stage7 retry blockers from separate failed transitions and must both be reconciled by checker evidence; the older one must not be ignored merely because a later retry exists.

contamination_barrier.0014 through contamination_barrier.0017 and contamination_barrier.0020 through contamination_barrier.0023 mark Stage7 verification_result, real_tool_results, debug_closure, and operator_leaf_promotion_certificate as planning/debug evidence only. Existing operator-leaf real-tool evidence may inform localization but cannot be claimed as a hardware or verification pass while these barriers are active.

retry_request.0003 remains open for artifact.stage8.repair_plan and targets Stage7 verification. Stage8 repair_plan and repair_execution_report are not trusted design inputs while contamination_barrier.0018 and contamination_barrier.0019 remain active.

The candidate_stage_artifact contains classified failures and contract-guided debug fields, but it does not provide checker evidence that closes any active SACG-memory retry request or contamination barrier.

The clean retry order is Stage6 verification contract repair/promote first, then Stage8 bounded repair dependency reconciliation, then Stage7 operator-leaf rerun or explicit reuse adjudication under the clean Stage6 contract, then single-transformer-layer verification before any board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime work.
proposed_actions: Publish the active blocker inventory and artifact trust matrix to repair.repair_boundary_engineer and repair.final_evidence_gate.
Treat all active-barrier Stage6, Stage7, and Stage8 artifacts as planning/debug evidence only until checker-backed SACG memory reconciliation clears or supersedes them.

Run a Stage6 verification-artifact retry using artifact.stage5.design_artifact_manifest, artifact.input.tool_protocols, and artifact.input.case_adapter; require verification plan, hierarchy, tool protocol, artifact contract, LLM action audit, and SACG reference checks before Stage7 is eligible.
Reconcile Stage8 bounded repair dependency after Stage6 is clean; do not use the current repair_plan or repair_execution_report as proof of correctness.

Adjudicate whether any old Stage7 evidence is reusable only after Stage6 and Stage8 blockers are resolved; default to rerun if any artifact hash, tool protocol, case adapter, numeric policy, data order, memory/runtime, or selected-scope binding is ambiguous.
Rerun Stage7 operator-leaf closure under the clean Stage6 contract, then execute single-transformer-layer closure before any board/backend actions.
Update SACG memory only after checker evidence exists; do not close retry requests or contamination barriers by assertion.

retry_dependency_order.required_resolution: Regenerate/refine and promote Stage6 verification_plan, verification_artifact_contract, and required audit/gate artifacts from artifact.stage5.design_artifact_manifest, artifact.input.tool_protocols, and artifact.input.case_adapter.
Reconcile bounded repair plan/execution under the clean Stage6 contract; either complete bounded repair closure or produce checker-backed supersession evidence.
Rerun or explicitly adjudicate Stage7 evidence under the clean contract; both active Stage7 retry records must be closed/superseded by checker evidence.
Update SACG memory so active contamination barriers for superseded failed artifacts are no longer current blockers before promotion is allowed.

risks: Cross-layer input consistency risk: Stage7 evidence generated against rejected Stage6 producer artifacts may not match the refined verification plan, tool protocol, hierarchy, data order, or artifact contract.
Evidence contamination risk: using current Stage7 real_tool_results or operator_leaf_promotion_certificate as a pass would bypass active barriers and failed verification_plan_static_check evidence.

Repair provenance risk: Stage8 repair_plan and repair_execution_report are useful for debugging, but they are not proof of repair closure until repair_boundary_check and SACG trust-barrier checks pass under a clean contract.
Duplicate retry risk: clearing only retry_request.0004 while leaving retry_request.0002 open would leave a current SACG-memory blocker against Stage7 promotion.

Numeric/data-order/memory/runtime risk: any reuse of old Stage7 evidence without artifact hash, numeric compare, transfer count, address map/data-order, and contract binding checks could mask mismatches introduced by Stage6 contract refinement or Stage8 repair.

Hierarchy risk: proceeding directly to board, AXI, DDR, Vivado, runtime, or app-shell integration before clean operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer closure would violate the required three-layer repair loop.

Human-boundary risk: any architecture, pipeline, memory layout, numeric policy, runtime ABI, or major template change discovered during repair requires approval and cannot be smuggled in as a verification-only retry.

edges: operator_leaf_closure -> single_transformer_layer_closure -> board/AXI/DDR/backend remains blocked until lower layers pass
